name: The Rome EDITION
positioning: Ian Schrager-programmed EDITION hotel near Via Veneto in central Rome, with a rooftop plunge pool and several bars
best_for: Travelers who want a base near Via Veneto and the Spanish Steps
Guests who like design-led hotels with distinctive bars

facts.text: The Rome EDITION was conceived, concepted and programmed by entrepreneur Ian Schrager.
The hotel is a few short steps from Via Veneto, Piazza Barberini, the Spanish Steps, the Trevi Fountain and the Borghese Gardens.
Many suites have panoramic views of the adjacent church of San Nicola da Tolentino and of Roman streets and roofs.
The suites have separate living and sleeping areas.
Family options are available upon request.
Anima, the hotel's signature restaurant, serves Italian dishes inspired by Rome and Naples, curated by Chef Antonio Gentile.
Anima has a courtyard with over 400 plants.
The Roof is on the seventh floor and has a panoramic terrace and a travertine plunge pool.
Punch Room is a speakeasy-inspired bar with amaranth-colored velvet sofas and cocktails that explore the influence of the Roman Empire.
Jade Bar has green marble interiors and a tasting ritual in collaboration with Le Labo.
The hotel has a heated rooftop plunge pool open all year round.
